@property --tw-ease { syntax: "*"; inherits: false; }
@property --tw-content { syntax: "*"; inherits: false; initial-value: ""; }
@property --tw-contain-size { syntax: "*"; inherits: false; }
@property --tw-contain-layout { syntax: "*"; inherits: false; }
@property --tw-contain-paint { syntax: "*"; inherits: false; }
@property --tw-contain-style { syntax: "*"; inherits: false; }
@keyframes spin { 
  100% { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}
@keyframes pulse { 
  50% { opacity: 0.5; }
}

:root { --font-anthropic-sans: "Anthropic Sans",ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif; }
@font-face { font-family: mc-anthropicons; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,") format("woff2"); font-display: block; }
[data-local-words], [data-local-glyph] { position: relative; }
[data-local-words]::before { content: attr(data-local-words); }
[data-local-words] > span { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); }
[data-local-hold]::before { position: absolute; inset: 0px; overflow: hidden; }
[data-local-hold] > span { position: static; width: auto; height: auto; overflow: visible; }
[data-local-glyph] { color: transparent; }
[data-local-glyph]::before { content: attr(data-local-glyph); position: absolute; inset: 0px; color: var(--drawn-ink,CanvasText); }
@media (forced-colors: active) {
  [data-local-glyph], [data-local-glyph]::before { forced-color-adjust: none; }
  [data-local-glyph]::before { color: canvastext; }
}
[data-local-words], [data-local-glyph] { user-select: none; }
[data-local-hold]::before { white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; text-decoration: inherit; }
.slides-card-title[data-local-hold]::before { bottom: auto; z-index: 1; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: anywhere; background: var(--card-ground); }
@page { size: 1920px 1080px; margin: 0px; }
.slides-print-sheet { display: none; }
@media print {
  #root { display: none !important; }
  [data-mc-chrome] { display: none !important; }
  .slides-print-sheet { display: block !important; }
  .slides-print-slide { break-after: page; break-inside: avoid; }
  .slides-print-slide:last-child { break-after: auto; }
}






@font-face {
  font-family: 'Space Grotesk';
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-display: swap;
  src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,") format('woff2');
  unicode-range: U+0000-00FF, U+0131, U+0152-0153, U+02BB-02BC, U+02C6, U+02DA, U+02DC, U+0304, U+0308, U+0329, U+2000-206F, U+20AC, U+2122, U+2191, U+2193, U+2212, U+2215, U+FEFF, U+FFFD;
}

</style>

<style>
html{background:#000;color-scheme:dark}
html.deck-js{overflow:hidden auto;scroll-snap-type:y mandatory;scrollbar-width:none}
html.deck-js::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
body{margin:0;background:#000;overflow:visible}
main{color-scheme:light}
.deck-slide{display:block;width:1920px;height:1080px}
.deck-fit{position:relative;width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:hidden}
.deck-scaler{width:1920px;height:1080px}
.deck-js .deck-slide{width:auto;height:100vh;height:100dvh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;scroll-snap-align:start;scroll-snap-stop:always}
.deck-js .deck-fit{flex:none;width:calc(1920px*var(--deck-s));height:calc(1080px*var(--deck-s))}
.deck-js .deck-scaler{transform:scale(var(--deck-s));transform-origin:0 0}
.deck-pager{position:fixed;z-index:3;right:16px;bottom:16px;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.7);color:#fff;font:12px/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s;pointer-events:none}
.deck-pager[data-on]{opacity:1}
@media (max-aspect-ratio:1/1){html.deck-js{scroll-snap-type:y proximity}.deck-js .deck-slide{height:auto;padding:6px 0;scroll-snap-stop:normal}.deck-js .deck-slide:first-child{padding-top:0}}
@media screen{html.deck-stage{overflow:hidden}.deck-stage body{overflow:hidden}.deck-stage main{position:fixed;inset:0}.deck-stage .deck-slide{position:absolute;inset:0;height:auto;padding:0;z-index:1}.deck-stage .deck-slide[data-off]{opacity:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:0}.deck-stage .deck-slide[data-leaving]{z-index:2;pointer-events:none}.deck-stage [data-build-hidden],.deck-stage [data-magic-hidden],.deck-stage [data-embed-under],.deck-stage [data-embed-dead] [data-embed-pic]{visibility:hidden}.deck-stage [data-embed-dead-label]{display:flex}}
[data-embed-dead-label]{display:none}
@page{size:1920px 1080px;margin:0}
@media print{html,html.deck-js,body{background:none;overflow:visible;height:auto;color-scheme:light}:root .deck-slide{display:block;height:auto;padding:0;break-after:page;page-break-after:always;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact;print-color-adjust:exact}:root .deck-slide:last-child{break-after:auto;page-break-after:auto}:root .deck-fit{width:auto;height:auto}:root .deck-scaler{transform:none}.deck-pager{display:none}iframe{display:none!important}}
</style>
